title: Cedarline Summit Terms: Further Extensions of a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Case
content:
These terms govern further extensions of the resolution deadline on a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case.

## Extension conditions in force

An extension adds the plan's extension days to the current resolution deadline. It is granted only to a borrower or confirmed successor whose declared intent is to sell or to retain the property and who is actively marketing the property or obtaining financing. This does not apply to the first extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's case whose borrower has died.

For a further extension on a Summit loan's case, and only for such an extension, the extension adds the further extension days to the current resolution deadline, on the same grant conditions.

An extension is granted only after HUD's extension approval for that extension number is recorded on the case. In addition:

- no case receives more than the plan's maximum number of extensions;
- a request beyond that limit is declined as extension limit reached;
- a request whose evidence is missing or of another kind is declined as evidence insufficient.

For an extension on a Summit loan's case, and only for such an extension, Cedarline approves the extension itself without any HUD step. The extension carries the number one higher than the extensions already granted on the case, under the same limit and decline reasons.

## Current supporting document

A further extension is not granted until the case carries an extension request awaiting a decision whose supporting document is dated no more than 30 days before the day that request was received.

| Supporting document of the request awaiting a decision | Received | Current for a further extension? |
|---|---|---|
| dated 30 days before receipt | (hypothetical) 31 July, document 1 July | yes |
| dated 31 days before receipt | (hypothetical) 31 July, document 30 June | no |

## Appraisal at the grant

Every extension sets the resolution deadline to the extended deadline. When the appraisal is older than the plan's appraisal validity, the extension also orders a new appraisal at the grant, wherever the plan's reappraisal-for-extension setting calls for one.

For the first extension on a Summit loan's case whose borrower has died, and for a further extension on a Summit loan's case, and only for such extensions:

- an appraisal older than the plan's appraisal validity is not reordered at the grant;
- it is replaced by a new one when a payoff or sale is next evaluated.

## Effect of the grant

The grant:

- books the further extension under the next extension number;
- moves the case's resolution deadline to the extended deadline, while the case stays in its extension period;
- marks the extension request accepted;
- sends the extension letter to the person acting on the case that day.

## Booking the grant: `grant_further_extension_50c8b1d2`

**Capability.** For a case whose extension period is running, one call does four things:

- records the extension under the extension number supplied, against the extension request named;
- moves the case's resolution deadline later by the extension days supplied, with the case staying in its extension period;
- marks that request accepted;
- records an extension letter dated today addressed to the person named.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `grant_further_extension_50c8b1d2` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `maturity_case_id` | reference number of the maturity case whose resolution deadline is extended | identifier |
| `maturity_request_id` | reference number of the extension request the extension is granted against, from the maturity request lookup or the receipt of the request's filing | identifier |
| `recipient_customer_id` | customer reference number of the person acting on the case, who receives the extension letter | identifier |
| `extension_number` | sequence number of this extension, counting every extension the case has been granted including this one | integer, starting at 1 |
| `extension_days` | whole number of calendar days by which the current resolution deadline is moved later | integer of 0 or more, no unit text, no decimals |

**Return.** A text rendering of a record with these fields:

- `maturity_case_id`;
- `extension_reference`;
- `letter_reference`;
- `extension_number`;
- `previous_resolution_deadline`;
- `extended_deadline`.

A receipt showing the extended deadline means the extension is granted and the letter recorded. An unknown case reference returns an error naming it.
